description: This file defines the class TestLogger within the namespace SuiteCRM\Test. It implements a logging utility primarily used for testing, capturing method calls, notes, and backtrace information, and providing mechanisms to filter and reset logs.

classes.name: TestLogger
classes.description: A test utility class for logging method calls and notes for test purposes within the SuiteCRM testing framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TestLogger and resets stored logs.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, logs method name and arguments, and records call details including timestamp and backtrace.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes filtered by specified levels, defaulting to 'fatal'.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all stored call and note data, resetting the logger state.
